title: lecanopteris pustulata subsp. howensis
intro: Lecanopteris pustulata subsp. howensis, commonly known as Howea fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is native to Australia and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lecanopteris pustulata subsp. howensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic activities, which may be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
